title: Buck Charlson, inventor of power steering and the Gerotor, backs Mishlove's work
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Buck Charlson, inventor of power steering and the Gerotor, backs Mishlove's work, about c. 1964 at Minnesota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: another major supporter of my work was a fellow named Buck Charlesson who invented power steering.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove is a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic abilities and life after death. He says that around 1964 in Minnesota, one of his major supporters was a man named Buck Charlson, who he says invented power steering and the Gerotor, a type of pump. He tells it to show that a serious practical engineer backed his unusual work.
